description: This file contains implementations related to a generic storage mechanism using Orleans framework constructs. It defines storage classes, a factory for creating storage instances, and extension methods for configuration within a silo builder.

classes.name: TableExampleStorage`1
classes.description: A generic storage class implementing IExampleStorage and ILifecycleParticipant, providing storage functionality for specific state type TState within Orleans grains.

classes.name: TableExampleStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of TableExampleStorage, configuring and participating them in grain lifecycle.

classes.name: TableExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add and configure TableExampleStorage services.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Asynchronous method to save the storage state. Currently a no-op returning completed task.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns string with storage details including name, activation status, and state type.

methods.name: LoadState
methods.description: Loads the state, sets activation flag to true, currently a no-op task.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the grain lifecycle for setup and state loading.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets the storage configuration using provided config object.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and configures a storage instance of TState for a given configuration, associating it with the grain context lifecycle.

methods.name: UseTableExampleStorage
methods.description: Extension method to configure an ISiloBuilder to include TableExampleStorage services with specified name.
